name: cosmic-tech
description: COSMIC technical breakdown: decomposes each functional process into 2-3 subprocesses — data movements (E/X/R/W) — with exact CFP counts checked against the plan estimate (never below it), refined from a green cosmic-func artifact (requires topic — one requirement per topic).

cfpPerFunc.description: Per-function CFP budget {value, min, max}; inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

cfpMin.description: Per-function CFP floor {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from below (rule plan/cfp-func-range); inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

cfpMax.description: Per-function CFP ceiling {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from above — a module larger than this must be split into several module functions (rule plan/cfp-func-range); inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

topicNo.description: Derived by the engine: requirement number extracted from the topic name via topicNoPattern (explicit values override); inherited along the chain; drives <artifactPrefix>-<topicNo>-<NN> artifact naming

topicNoPattern.description: Regex (first capture group, else whole match) extracting the requirement number from the topic name, e.g. topic 'KERQ-352 收藏夹' → KERQ-352

cfpTotal.description: Total CFP budget {value, downFactor, upFactor}; per-process CFP checks use the downFactor/upFactor tolerance band around desiredCfps (rules tech/cfp-total-vs-budget, tech/cfp-budget-advice)

cfpPerSubProc.description: Average CFP per data movement; sizing guidance carried down the chain

targetIndex.description: 1-based position of the target function in the upstream plan functions array; no default — pick from the candidates listed when missing
